name: stepquest-native
description: Step Quest as an installed iPhone / Android app with automatic step sync (Apple Health, Health Connect).

scripts.add: npm run web && npx cap add ios && npx cap add android && node scripts/patch-native.mjs
scripts.add:android: npm run web && npx cap add android && node scripts/patch-native.mjs
scripts.add:ios: npm run web && npx cap add ios && node scripts/patch-native.mjs
scripts.sync: npm run web && npx cap sync && node scripts/patch-native.mjs
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
